introHtml: Koozie is known for durable, insulated drinkware that keeps beverages hot or cold for hours. Their tumblers and travel mugs come in stainless steel and double-wall vacuum construction, ideal for commuters, outdoor events, and corporate gifts. Whether you choose the 16 oz Malmo Travel Mug or the 15 oz Cayman Travel Tumbler, each piece offers a large imprint area for your logo or message. Customize with full-color pad printing or laser engraving for a polished look that lasts.
